newsitem.title: USA: Hearst names publisher for "Popular Mechanics".
newsitem.headline: Hearst names publisher for "Popular Mechanics".

text.p: Hearst Magazines said Wednesday it named Jay McGill publisher of its "Popular Mechanics" magazine, succeeding Robert Dillingham, who will retire on June 20.

Earlier this week, Hearst Magazines promoted McGill to the newly-created position of publishing director, overseeing Popular Mechanics as well as "Sports Afield" and "Motor Boating & Sailing," although he will not serve as publisher for the latter two.
Hearst Magazines, a division of the privately-held Hearst Corp, publishes monthly magazines, with distribution in more than 100 countries.
